If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

  


Rotating \- 08 Hour (United States of America)**This is a Stanford Health Care job.**  

  

**A Brief Overview**  

The Patient Access Services job is responsible for completing patient admissions and registration functions. Identifies patients' insurance coverage or existing financial resources to pay for medical care and services. Handles routine customer service inquiries and concerns. Processes necessary admission/registration paperwork and obtains necessary documents for billing and compliance requirements. The PAR I position is intended as an entry\-level position for individuals with limited background in patient admitting/registration, recent graduates from trade schools and training programs, and/or experience in non\-healthcare with customer service background. It is expected that individuals on this level will acquire the necessary job skills, knowledge, and other qualifications through on\-the\-job and/or formal training to advance to the Patient Access Representative level II with a minimum of 1\-year experience within Patient Access Services.  

  

**Locations**  

Stanford Health Care  

  

**What you will do**

* Assures secure handling and accurate recording of payments collected at the point\-of\-service delivery.
* Builds a foundational understanding of the different health insurance coverage options and the related processes and procedures.
* Able to handle routine/simple patient escalations and perform service recovery.
* Escalates any advanced or complex registrations to a more experienced team member.
* Greets patients and begins the registration process. Maintains professional communication with various PAS staff, clinical staff, physicians, guests, and patients regarding the admitting/registration services rendered at Stanford Health Care \- ValleyCare. Communication may consist of telephone correspondence, email, or in person contact.
* Meets weekly individual productivity and key performance indicators and standards while following planned priorities as set by the department leadership team.
* Provides excellent customer service to all individuals with whom the employee has contact.
* The specific job duties will be comprised of a combination of responsibilities for all areas of Patient Access Service operations.

 **Education Qualifications**


High School Diploma or GED  

* 

  

**Experience Qualifications**


One (1\) year of progressively responsible and directly related work experience. Required  

* 

  

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Language: Bilingual preferred (English and Spanish).
* Ability to speak and write effectively at a level appropriate for the job.
* Ability to work well with individuals at all levels of the organization.
* Knowledge of computer systems and software used in functional area.
Knowledge of Medical Terminology such as Medicare, Medi\-Cal, Workers Comp, Managed Care (HMO, PPO, POS, etc.), Children's Health Programs (CCS, GHPP, Healthy Families, etc.).  
* 

  

**These principles apply to ALL employees:**  

  

**SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient \& Family Experience**  

  

*Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C\-I\-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C\-I\-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient\-experience and represents a framework for patient\-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.*  

  

*You will do this by executing against our three experience pillars, from the patient and family’s perspective:*

  

* Know Me: Anticipate my needs and status to deliver effective care
* Show Me the Way: Guide and prompt my actions to arrive at better outcomes and better health
* Coordinate for Me: Own the complexity of my care through coordination

Accordingly, SHC does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation or gender identity and/or expression, religion, age, national or ethnic origin, political beliefs, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, veteran status, or disability, or the perception of any of the above. People of all genders, members of all racial and ethnic groups, people with disabilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply. Qualified applicants with criminal convictions will be considered after an individualized assessment of the conviction and the job requirements.**


Base Pay Scale: Generally starting at $29\.92 \- $33\.72 per hour

jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**


Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

 **About the role**


Crowe’s Metals \& Materials Consulting practice is expanding, and we are seeking an experienced **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Consultant** to help shape the future of our D365 practice. This role offers the opportunity to lead solution architecture, influence major transformation initiatives, and work directly with finance and operations leaders across manufacturing and distribution organizations.

  

If you want meaningful impact, autonomy, and a clear path to practice leadership, this is a strategic career opportunity—not just another consulting role.

 **What You Will Lead and Influence**

* Architect and lead end\-to\-end D365 Finance solutions that deliver measurable outcomes for mid\-market and enterprise clients.
* Advise senior stakeholders, including CFOs and Operations leaders, to define requirements and design transformation roadmaps.
* Set solution direction and guide delivery teams to ensure projects meet scope, quality, and client expectations.
* Lead functional design, feature optimization, data integrity, and user experience improvements to maximize platform value.
* Participate in quality reviews and steer project teams through design, prototyping, and deployment phases.
* Contribute to Crowe’s methodologies, accelerators, and best practices; mentor team members; and support the growth of our D365 offering.
* Engage in team\-building and internal initiatives, leveraging non\-client time for personal development and practice enhancement.

 **What Makes Crowe a Strong Career Move**

* **High\-impact role** with direct influence on solution strategy and client outcomes.
* **Rapidly growing D365 Finance practice** backed by a nationally recognized consulting brand.
* **Clear advancement path** into Solution Architect, Industry Lead, or Practice Leadership roles.
* **Strong investment in your development** (certification support, training, conferences, thought leadership opportunities).
* **Collaborative culture** that values quality, innovation, and balanced workloads.
* **Flexible work environment** with predictable, project\-based travel (25%–50%).

 **Experience That Makes You Successful (Must\-Have)**

* Bachelors degree required.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on D365 Finance implementation leadership or equivalent ERP delivery experience.
* Proven track record delivering complex, full\-lifecycle D365 Finance projects.
* Strong functional expertise across core finance and operational modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, Cash/Bank, Reporting, etc.).
* Ability to lead solution architecture, translate requirements into actionable designs, and guide teams through execution.
* Excellent communication skills with experience engaging C\-suite and director\-level stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, produce high\-quality work products, and lead engagements with minimal oversight.

 **Preferred**

* Experience in Manufacturing or Distribution environments; Metals industry exposure highly valued.
* Strong functional expertise across operational modules (Procurement, Inventory, etc.).
* Experience with complementary ISV solutions within the D365 ecosystem.
* D365 certifications in Finance or related modules; CPA, CMA, or CFA a plus.
* Prior consulting experience within a professional services environment.

 **Why You’ll Thrive Here**

* Opportunity to shape the direction of the D365 practice.
* Access to diverse and challenging client environments.
* Supportive leadership that values initiative and thought leadership.
* Competitive compensation with performance incentives.

jobs.title: Sr. Strategic Operations Associate, Catering Growth
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  

  

This operations role sits within Uber for Business \- one of Uber's fastest growing business units in terms of topline performance. Within this org, you'll join the founding team responsible for building and scaling Catering. Catering is an exciting strategic priority across both Uber for Business and the Delivery organization as a whole, changing the ways in which consumers and business customers use UberEats.  

  

Working alongside the U4B Head of Catering, you'll play a central role in designing how Catering is sold and supported at scale. This will consist of defining and improving the end\-to\-end commercial motion, identifying opportunities across both existing and new U4B clients, and designing the processes, tools, and operating models that help our Sales organization grow Catering efficiently. Sitting at the intersection of Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing, Strategy and Operations, you'll help define how Catering scales from a small pilot product into a core part of Uber's business.  

  

**What You'll Do*** Sales Motion Design: Design, test, and continuously improve the end\-to\-end Catering sales motion, including prospecting, qualification, handoffs, onboarding, and post\-sale support.
* Growth Strategy: Develop top\-down and bottom\-up approaches to identify Catering opportunities across the U4B book of business, including strategies to penetrate existing accounts and land new business.
* Commercial Experimentation: Design and evaluate sales sprints, incentives, lead\-generation approaches, and other commercial experiments that improve conversion and accelerate growth.
* Performance \& Modeling: Build analyses and quantitative models that diagnose funnel performance, identify constraints, size opportunities, and inform recommendations on where to invest.
* Cross\-Functional Partnership: Partner closely with Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing, BDRs, Operations, and Analytics teams to translate strategy into scalable field execution.

**Basic Qualifications*** Bachelor's Degree
* Experience: At least 4 years of experience in sales strategy, revenue operations, strategy \& operations, commercial transformation, sales, or a related field.
* Commercial Acumen: Strong understanding of B2B sales motions and customer needs, with the ability to translate commercial opportunities into practical operating models and processes.
* Analytical Skills: Strong quantitative problem\-solving skills with experience using data and modeling to evaluate performance, diagnose opportunities, and support business decisions.
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to challenge existing ways of working, develop new approaches from first principles, and translate strategy into scalable execution.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience influencing cross\-functional stakeholders and translating strategy into clear guidance for the field.

**Preferred Qualifications*** B2B Sales Strategy and/or Revenue Operations: Experience designing or transforming enterprise sales processes, operating models, or go\-to\-market motions.
* Field Experience: Direct experience in a sales role, or demonstrated empathy for seller workflows and the practical realities of executing a commercial motion.
* Experimentation: Experience designing, testing, and iterating on commercial programs rather than only optimizing established processes.
* Creative Problem Solving: Comfort developing outside\-the\-box solutions in a greenfield environment where the right sales model has not yet been established.
* Adaptability: Exceptional ability to prioritize competing workstreams, operate independently, and navigate ambiguity with a bias toward action.

  

For New York City, NY\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $131,000 per year \- USD $145,000 per year.  

  

For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $131,000 per year \- USD $145,000 per year.  

  

For Chicago, IL\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $118,000 per year \- USD $131,000 per year.  

  

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

At Sparklight, a Cable One brand, we believe in a neighborly approach—connecting people to what matters most. Are you ready to play a key role in this mission?


As Customer Care and Sales Advisor I, you’ll be the supportive voice and solutions partner for our customers. Whether assisting with billing questions, scheduling service, or guiding product changes, you’ll build trust by listening empathetically and responding clearly. * Demonstrated patience and professionalism in all customer interactions
* Working knowledge of Cable One products and services

* Ability to remain composed and empathetic in high\-pressure situations
* Ability to sit for extended periods, use hands, talk, and hear
* May be required to lift up to 10 pounds

jobs.title: Product Manager, Care Operations Platform
jobs.description:
About Caret Health

Caret Health runs care coordination for rural and critical\-access hospitals. Rural hospitals are accountable for value\-based\-care outcomes and eligible for reimbursable programs — remote patient monitoring, chronic and transitional care management, annual wellness visits, quality\-gap closure, cancer navigation — that they have nobody to staff. We supply both: the platform the programs run on, and, where a customer wants it, the people who run them.

That combination makes us unusual. The clinical platform is licensed and used directly by hospital care teams, and it is also the system our own staff work when we deliver programs on a customer's behalf. It carries real clinical operations across 50\+ hospitals and a large rural patient panel — quality measures tracked, discharges worked against a 48\-hour clock, monitoring alerts triaged, billable time documented.

This role owns that platform.

**The role**

You will own the **Care Operations Platform**: the system care teams work in every day to run every program we deliver. Patient records and statuses, protocol and tasking engines, work queues, task outcomes, the team inbox, multi\-program logic, roles and access — plus the integrations that feed it.

The bar is high. These are people doing clinical work under deadlines, on patients with real conditions, in organizations that are already short\-staffed. A confusing screen costs time that a rural care team does not have. A broken data feed means a care gap nobody knows about.

This is an execution\-heavy product role with room to grow into strategy. You'll run discovery, write the specs, own the planning, run the release train for your area, and be accountable for whether what you shipped actually got adopted. You'll report to the Chief Product Officer, who currently carries this scope directly — your first job is to take it off their plate and run it better.

**What you'll own**

**Platform ownership.** The clinical platform end to end: roadmap, backlog, specs, and outcomes. You decide what gets built next in your area and say no to the rest, using a simple test — does it protect revenue, improve our cost\-per\-outcome, or advance our AI and data position?

**Discovery and research.** Run a continuous loop with the care teams, team leads, and operations managers who use the platform. Watch the work as it actually happens and turn observations into a ranked, evidenced problem list rather than a wish list. You'll be the person who can say what actually slows a care team down, with numbers attached.

**Integrations.** Clinical data arrives from EHRs, payer sources, monitoring devices, telephony and messaging providers, and partner platforms. You own the product side of these: what we ingest, how it maps, what happens when a field is missing or a feed goes quiet. Integrations must be **seamless for the user and observable for us** — a care team should never have to think about where the data came from, and we should know a pipeline is degraded before a customer tells us.

**Hypotheses and metrics.** Every meaningful thing you ship starts as a stated hypothesis — what we believe, what we expect to change, how we'll know — and ships with success metrics defined before the build. You'll instrument the work, read the results honestly, and kill what didn't work. Our product analytics stack is already in place and under\-used; you'll change that.

**Planning and delivery.** Break quarterly direction into epics, specs, and well\-written tickets. Own sprint planning and the backlog with the engineering leads. Keep cross\-team dependencies visible and resolved before they become slips.

**Release management.** Own the release train for your area: scope, readiness, regression coverage with QA, release notes, rollout, and what happens when something goes wrong. Our cycle is slower than it should be — shrinking it, safely, is one of the things we'll measure you on.

**Adoption.** Shipping is half the job. You own whether features are actually used: rollout plans, in\-product guidance, enablement materials and documentation, adoption targets per release, and follow\-up on the ones that miss. A feature sitting at 11% adoption is an open problem, not a completed ticket.

**Practices.** Help raise how the whole product function works — brief and spec templates, definition of ready and done, the decision log, the metrics review. We're building the PM layer close to from scratch, and you'll leave real fingerprints on it.

What we're looking for

**Required**

* 3–5 years as a product manager, **including healthcare product experience** — clinical workflow, care management, population health, digital health, RCM, or an equivalent regulated clinical domain
* Hands\-on experience owning **integrations with third\-party systems** — EHRs, clearinghouses, device or telephony vendors, data partners — and a clear point of view on what makes an integration feel seamless to the user and observable to the team running it
* A track record of shipping: features that reached production and changed a number you can name
* Experience with workflow\-heavy products used by demanding daily users under time pressure
* Strong discovery instincts — you go to where the work happens rather than relying on tickets and secondhand requests
* Fluency with metrics. You can define them, instrument them, question them, and resist the pretty ones that don't drive decisions
* Excellent written communication. We run on written briefs, specs, and decisions across several time zones
* Comfort owning a release process: coordinating QA, managing scope under deadline, and being accountable when it slips
* Enough technical depth to hold a real design discussion with engineers — you don't need to code, but you do need to understand what you're asking for
* Authorized to work in the US

**A strong plus**

* Working knowledge of quality measures and gap closure (HEDIS or similar) — specs, eligibility, evidence, measurement per

jobs.description:
**Department:** Professional Services


**Salary:** $125,000\-$175,000


**FLSA Status:** Exempt


**Positions Supervised:** TBD


**Location:** Remote


**Created/Updated:** September 29, 2026



### **About the Role**


The Project Manager will own Consortium's Project Management Office (PMO) and is responsible for the standards, processes, and governance that guide every professional services engagement, in addition to coordinating and monitoring the execution of multiple concurrent, client\-facing projects from initiation through closeout.

  



This role partners with service leaders, project teams, clients, Finance \& Accounting, Contracting, and other stakeholders to drive projects forward and ensure they are delivered against agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, and contractual commitments. The Project Manager provides ongoing visibility into project performance — including milestones, resource requirements, budget performance, risks, issues, and forecasted outcomes — and serves as the primary owner of consistency and accountability across engagements.

  



As the organization continues to mature its PMO, this role owns the continuous adoption and improvement of standardized processes and governance practices, ensuring they are defined, maintained, and followed consistently across all projects and delivery teams.

  



### **Essential Responsibilities**


* Own and maintain the Project Governance Framework — the standards, templates, methodology, and delivery requirements that govern project and services quality and consistency across the organization.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies, tracking progress toward each milestone.
* Build standardized kickoff decks and lead both internal kickoff reviews and customer\-facing kickoff calls.
* Coordinate with internal delivery teams on resourcing decisions and serve as the primary point of contact for customers on project status, timelines, and reporting; actively monitor project schedule, budget, milestones, and deliverables to ensure timely, uninterrupted completion of projects.
* Run status meetings with follow\-up notes, maintaining a consistent reporting cadence with both customers and internal leadership.
* Enforce time\-entry compliance across assigned consultants, and track budget hours and dollars against actual utilization, flagging variances early.
* Document all scope, schedule, or budget changes as formal change orders before associated work begins.
* Identify and escalate delivery, scope, or budget risks per the Project Governance Framework's escalation path, driving resolution to all project\-related risks and issues.
* Partner with Finance/Accounting on invoicing and forecasting inputs.
* Manage project closeout — gathering deliverables, closing tasks, storing documentation, and verifying invoicing.
* Support after\-action/lessons\-learned reviews for projects as required.
* Own the continual improvement of PMO processes and the project delivery experience, driving adoption across all delivery teams in partnership with leadership.
* Other duties as necessary to ensure profitability and/or as directed by management.

### **Desired Skills \& Experience**


* Experience building, running, or maturing a PMO — including defining standards, templates, and governance frameworks and driving adoption across teams outside direct reporting lines.
* Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, resource allocation, risks, issues, and forecasting across multiple concurrent client engagements.
* Experience with CRM and professional services automation (PSA) platforms.
* Familiarity with revenue recognition concepts, milestone\-based billing, and working alongside Finance/Accounting teams.
* Comfortable engaging stakeholders at all levels, internally and with clients.
* Outstanding time management and organizational skills.
* Strong communication and presentation skills; comfortable running both internal and customer\-facing meetings.
* Detail\-oriented, with a track record of enforcing process discipline across project teams.
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast\-paced consulting or professional services environment.

### **Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of project management experience, ideally within a cybersecurity consulting or professional services organization.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification strongly preferred.

### **Success Metrics**


* Budget variance — planned vs. actual hours and dollars.
* On\-time delivery against the committed schedule.
* Utilization of assigned consultants against planned hours.
* Forecast accuracy — quarterly Rev/Rec forecast vs. actual.
* Timely and accurate project reporting.
* Client and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Adoption of, and compliance with, PMO processes and governance across all delivery teams.
* Progress against the PMO maturity roadmap defined in the Project Governance Framework.

### **Additional Info**


Consortium Networks is dedicated to supporting our employees through comprehensive benefits, including full coverage for medical, dental, and vision care, a generous paid time off policy, and a positive, growth\-oriented work environment.

  



**Equal Opportunity Employer**


Consortium Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

The compensation range considers a wide range of factors which are considered in making compensation decisions including skills, experience, education

Versar Global Solutions is seeking a full\-time Project Coordinator who will possess knowledge and experience helping project managers build and manage scopes of work required in the performance of a United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Recurring Maintenance and Minor Repair (RMMR) task order. The Onboarding Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for accepted candidates and works closely with Recruiting, HR, Training, IT, and Operations to create a seamless transition from **candidate to new employee**.

 The Quality Assurance Manager provides day\-to\-day leadership for key Quality Management System (QMS) processes and the Quality team, ensuring continued suitability, compliance, and scalability of the QMS as the business grows. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

**About This Role:**


The Sales Operations organization is looking for a talented Sales Operations Analyst to drive strategic analytics, decision intelligence, and insights for the sales and partner management teams.  



  

You’ll work cross\-functionally to frame ambiguous business questions, gather and organize complex data, and turn insights into actionable recommendations and reusable business capabilities.

**What You Will Do:**

* Deep dive into complex data sets to draw insights to help the business understand marketplace dynamics and proactively address challenges; define and build reporting infrastructure to improve visibility and performance tracking
* Identify key performance indicators and competitive insights for use by sales leaders and executives to manage the business. Establish and lead operating processes for effectively managing the organization, including actively tracking key trends in lagging/leading metrics.
* Support execution and improvement in current sales processes including goal setting, forecasting, KPI reporting and dashboard management
* Partner with sales executives on all operational and analytical requests (e.g. team restructuring, quota setting, territory planning, business performance analyses, etc.)
* Play a pivotal role in our annual strategic planning process by making recommendations in areas such as how to organize territories and improve rep productivity
* Establish strong working relationships with sales leadership, business operations, systems, and other cross\-functional teams to achieve objectives without management involvement
* Coordinate and lead efforts to drive awareness and understanding of reports \& dashboard among reps, sales leaders and executives
* Lead initiatives end to end—from problem framing and MVP prioritization through launch, measurement, and follow\-through—while creating durable organizational capacity
* Work directly with data to assess grain, definitions, quality, validation, analytical feasibility, model limitations, and monitoring so outputs are trusted and maintainable
* Build reusable decision\-intelligence platforms and operating capabilities—not one\-off dashboards or analyses—with strong governance, documentation, automation, and adoption mechanisms
* Translate ambiguous commercial and strategic opportunities into clearly defined decisions, requirements, roadmaps, and pragmatic first releases
* Support ad\-hoc projects and report requests as needed

 **What We Want To See:**

* BA/BS Degree; Degree in Business, Finance or Accounting is a plus
* 5\+ years of hands\-on analyst experience in Sales Ops
* Strong attention to detail \- you can make sense of the complex
* Creative problem\-solving skills with the ability to multi\-task and prioritize business requirements in a dynamic, fast paced environment
* Obsession with finding process improvements and efficiencies to improve workflow
* Advanced MS Excel skills (i.e. pivot tables, building complex formulas)
* Experience building reusable systems, automation, governance, or operating mechanisms that remain useful beyond the initial project
* Strong ownership, integrity, and follow\-through \- including the willingness to surface inconvenient truths, acknowledge mistakes, respectfully challenge assumptions, and remain accountable after launch
* Ability to communicate complex analytical and technical concepts simply, tailor depth to the audience, make recommendations clearly, preserve material uncertainty, and influence without authority
* Strong problem\-framing and strategic judgment, including the ability to select rules, heuristics, analytics, or predictive methods based on decision value, data maturity, interpretability, implementation effort, and risk
* Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar business and technical domains quickly, test assumptions, correct misunderstandings, and apply new knowledge to consequential recommendations
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal
* Strong service\-orientation — you know how to partner cross\-functionally
* Experience with data analytics and reporting; experience with databases/data warehouses and data querying languages such as Snowflake and SQL
* Experience using Salesforce is highly preferred
* Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong documentation skills
* Experience with Tableau
* Ability to travel, up to 15%

 **What’s in It for You:**

* Strong organization and time management skills with the demonstrated ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

jobs.title: Care Advocate
jobs.description:
Seven Starling is a leading virtual provider of women's behavioral health services supporting every stage of motherhood. Seven Starling's holistic clinical model combines specialized therapy, peer support, and medication management to effectively treat common perinatal mood disorders like postpartum depression and anxiety, with 94% of patients seeing a clinically significant improvement in their symptoms after completing the program. Seven Starling partners with OBGYN clinics across the country and leading health plans including UnitedHealthCare, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Aetna to make care easily accessible and affordable.



### **Position Overview**


Seven Starling is looking to add a world\-class Care Advocate to join our Care Support team. Our ideal candidate is an experienced support professional who is passionate about improving women’s mental health outcomes, and is energized by the opportunity to ensure our patients receive compassionate and effective mental health care and our clinicians treating them receive world class support. You will excel in this role if you have a strong attention to detail, love staying organized, enjoy learning new systems and tools, have experience in high\-volume settings, and are skilled at developing and implementing scalable processes that help our operations run efficiently.

### **What you’ll do**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for patients and providers, addressing their questions, concerns, and needs in a professional and empathetic manner.
* Assist with scheduling and rescheduling patient appointments to maximize patient engagement and success, including managing conflicts and optimizing appointment schedules.
* Maintain accurate patient records and documentation, ensuring data is up\-to\-date and compliant with privacy regulations.
* Assist in the resolution of patient or provider issues or complaints, escalating more complex concerns to the appropriate team members or supervisors.
* Serve as the “voice of the patient”, keeping a close eye on data and trends from your support work and surfacing learnings to the appropriate team members or supervisors.
* Provide support to patients and providers navigating the healthcare system, including explaining procedures, insurance processes, and available resources.
* Coordinate care activities, including follow\-up appointments, outside referrals, and coordination with other healthcare providers as needed.
* Collaborate with healthcare professionals and administrative staff to ensure seamless patient care and communication.
* Participate in ongoing training and development to stay current with best practices and organizational changes.
* Propose updates to key processes as needed to maintain them.

### **Who you are**

* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience in a patient support, customer service, or healthcare\-related role.
* Experience in a remote work environment.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities, especially in a high\-volume setting. Strong attention to detail.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact effectively with patients, families, and healthcare professionals.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism.
* Proficiency in using standard office applications (e.g., Google Suite).
* Demonstrated problem\-solving skills and a proactive approach to patient support.
* High school diploma or equivalent; additional coursework in healthcare administration or a related field is a plus.

### **Perks and Benefits**

* Competitive paid time off
* Competitive parental leave and return to work policy
* One\-time stipend to enhance your work from home experience
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K
* Annual stipend for your choice of wellness benefits
* Annual professional development stipend
* Virtual team events

* This position is eligible for over\-time
* Meaningful equity package with significant upside potential

jobs.title: Patient Access & Eligibility Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Patient Access \& Eligibility Specialist**


 Overview:


The Patient Access \& Eligibility Specialist plays a critical role in supporting patient access to care management services by ensuring accurate insurance verification, confirming program eligibility, and assisting patients through administrative intake processes.


This role serves as the front door to the care management program, helping identify eligible patients for Chronic Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), and other virtual care services.


The Patient Access \& Eligibility Specialist verifies insurance coverage, confirms patient eligibility, answers incoming patient calls, manages voicemail communications, and ensures accurate documentation within electronic medical record (EMR) systems and care management platforms.


The ideal candidate has strong technical proficiency, excellent communication skills, and the ability to navigate multiple healthcare systems efficiently while delivering a professional and compassionate patient experience.


Reports To: Nursing Manager


Department: Clinical Operations

**Job Description**:

**Patient Call Management \& Communication**

* Answer incoming patient calls and provide professional, courteous assistance.
* Respond to patient inquiries related to care management programs and services.
* Manage voicemail systems by reviewing incoming messages and ensuring calls are routed to the appropriate team member or department.
* Coordinate call routing to Care Coordinators, Enrollment Specialists, or other staff based on patient needs.
* Ensure patient messages are handled promptly and accurately to support timely follow\-up.
* Document all patient communications within the care management platform.
* Maintain strict adherence to HIPAA and patient privacy standards during all interactions.

**Insurance Verification \& Eligibility Determination**

* Verify patient insurance coverage and eligibility for care management programs.
* Confirm payer requirements for Chronic Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), and other services.
* Review patient benefits, coverage status, and eligibility criteria.
* Identify patients who qualify for enrollment in care management programs.
* Document eligibility verification results in the appropriate systems.

**Enrollment Pipeline Support**

* Prepare eligible patient lists for the Enrollment team by verifying eligibility and insurance coverage.
* Flag patients who meet program criteria for outreach and enrollment.
* Support enrollment readiness by ensuring patient demographic and insurance data is accurate.
* Communicate eligibility findings with Enrollment Specialists to support effective patient outreach.
* Assist with administrative preparation for patient enrollment processes.

**Administrative \& Platform Support**

* Maintain accurate patient demographic and insurance information within care management platform.
* Assist with patient record updates and administrative workflows related to care management services.
* Ensure documentation is accurate, complete and compliant with program requirements.
* Support internal teams with patient information verification and administrative tasks.

**Technology \& Data Accuracy**

* Utilize electronic medical records (EMR), care management platforms, and telephony systems to support patient access workflows.
* Demonstrate strong technical proficiency when navigating multiple healthcare platforms simultaneously.
* Maintain a high level of accuracy when entering patient information into healthcare systems.
* Assist with resolving minor data discrepancies and escalate system issues when necessary.

**Qualifications and Skills Required:**

* 1–3 years of experience in healthcare administration, patient access, insurance verification, or care coordination support
* Experience verifying health insurance eligibility and benefits
* Familiarity with Chronic Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), or population health programs preferred
* Experience working with electronic medical record (EMR) systems
* Strong technical proficiency and ability to learn new healthcare platforms quickly
* Experience handling patient phone calls in a professional healthcare environment
* Excellent verbal communication and patient engagement skills
* Strong organizational and time management abilities
* High attention to detail and documentation accuracy

**Competencies:**


Competency

  

Definition

  

Patient Communication

  

Provides clear, compassionate communication when assisting patients.

  

Insurance Verification

  

Demonstrates strong understanding of insurance coverage and eligibility processes.

  

Technical Acumen

  

Navigates EMR systems and healthcare technology platforms efficiently.

  

Attention to Detail.

  

Ensures accuracy in documentation and patient data entry.

  

Compliance Awareness

  

Maintains HIPAA compliance and proper handling of protected health information.

  

Organization

  

Manages multiple tasks and systems effectively in a fast\-paced environment.

  

Collaboration

  

Works closely with Enrollment Specialists, Care Coordinators, and operations staff.

  


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Insurance verification accuracy rate
* Eligibility verification turnaround time
* Patient call response quality and timeliness
* Voicemail response and routing accuracy.

**Work Location, Shift \& Schedule**  

  

This position is remote (please see remote requirements below). Shifox/Alopex employees work Monday\-Friday r according to the business hours of client practices.  

  

**Remote Position Requirements:**  

Reliable and stable Internet – all programs used by **Patient Access \& Eligibility Specialist** are internet based. A quiet and professional work environment suitable for speaking with patients about sensitive information and Protected Health Information (PHI), free of distractions.  

  

**Compensation**:

The Regional Account Manager position for the Northeast Region is responsibility for New York and surrounding states. The Regional Account Manager will exceed or achieve sales quota by delivering market share growth as well as other key performance metrics. The BDM implements the brand strategy and tactics within the assigned region and also works to accomplish call points at Hospitals, IDN systems, ASC’s, and alternate healthcare facilities. The BDM influences clinical and non\-clinical collaborators to support the use of the company’s annual subscription\-based platform solutions to include CensiTrac, ScopeTrac, LoanerLink, Analytics, and any new commercially released products by applying effective selling skills, in\-depth clinical and business expertise, CRM tool, and Assessment/return on investment tools as needed.  

  

The Regional Account Manager approaches each customer from a total account management perspective by using resources appropriately and collaborating with business partners. In addition, the Regional Account Manager accurately articulates the value proposition for the customer, including collaborators such as surgeons, clinical leaders, surgical business managers, central sterile managers and staff, IT management, Endoscopic managers, and supply chain.

* Driving specialty product sales into assigned region including new and existing customers.

* Assisting the National Account, Channel Management, and Client Services Teams in driving unit sales volume.
* Developing and encouraging strong customer relationships, building brand loyalty, and driving current customer expansion through new product sales.
* Ability to plan, prioritize, lead, and track all sales cycle events.
* Present and demo the patient safety and business benefits of the Censis solutions through individual and committee meeting channels.
* Responsible for forecasting, monitoring, and posting sales activities within the assigned region.
* Build and maintain a clinical and technical knowledge expertise.

 **Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 5 years related sales experience selling healthcare technology applications and/or technical clinical solutions in a hospital environment.
* Experience calling on multi\-departmental hospital middle management executives at the account and IDN level.
* Experience using disciplined approach and previous experience with team selling.
* Call point experience with OR, Central Sterile, ENDO, and IT.
* Ability to travel extensively including overnights within the designated geography. Travel expectation 50% \- 70%.

* Highly developed interpersonal/communication skills with the demonstrated record of influence.
* Excellent verbal and written communication technique.
* Strong Team skills in both leading and contributing.
* Develop and drive a focused consultative sales process as an individual contributor and within a team selling environment.
* Call point expertise with OR, Central Sterile, ENDO, IT and Materials Management departments.
* Ability to develop multi\-departmental hospital middle management executive champions at the account and IDN level.
* Strong discernment and excellent negotiation, influencing, business planning, sales strategy, problem solving, decision making and time management skills.
* Must have an execution core mentality with the support of a self\-motivated desire to accept technical knowledge and build success pathways to overcome obstacles.
* Proficient with MS Office Suite, Salesforce.com CRM, WebEx, Microsoft Teams, Open Voice, and Vendor Credentialing Services.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager III
jobs.description:
**About Nexcess**


Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission\-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

**Overview**
============


The Technical Account Manager III serves as the highest\-level technical advisor and strategic partner for the organization’s most complex, strategic, or high\-impact customers. This role provides expert guidance on sophisticated hosting environments, long\-term architecture strategy, technical risk, scalability, security, and business continuity.


The TAM III operates with substantial autonomy and organizational influence. This role leads complex customer initiatives and serves as the senior escalation point for critical technical and customer matters.

**Compensation**  

The base salary for this position is between $110k\-$130k plus commission

**Responsibilities**

**Executive and Strategic Customer Partnership**
------------------------------------------------

* Serves as the primary technical authority for the organization’s most complex, strategic, or high\-impact customers.
* Builds trusted relationships with customer executives, technical leaders, and other key stakeholders.
* Develops a comprehensive understanding of customer business models, growth strategies, risk tolerance, and technical objectives.
* Leads executive\-level account reviews, architecture reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
* Influences customer retention, growth, and investment decisions through expert consultation and demonstrated technical value.
* Anticipates evolving customer needs and recommends solutions before they become operational risks.

**Advanced Architecture and Technical Leadership**
--------------------------------------------------

* Leads the assessment and design of highly complex, distributed, or business\-critical hosting environments.
* Provides expert guidance on architecture, performance, security, scalability, resilience, and business continuity.
* Evaluates complex technical dependencies and develops solutions that balance performance, risk, cost, and operational sustainability.
* Establishes technical standards and strategic recommendations for customer environments.
* Reviews and validates technical designs, blueprints, and improvement plans developed by other team members.
* Identifies systemic risks and opportunities affecting multiple customers, platforms, or service offerings.
* Partners with senior Engineering, Product, and Operations leaders on complex customer solutions.

**Critical Initiatives and Escalation Leadership**
--------------------------------------------------

* Leads high\-risk migrations, platform transformations, architecture redesigns, and other complex technical initiatives.
* Serves as a senior escalation point for critical, highly visible, or prolonged customer issues.
* Establishes technical response strategies, ownership, communication expectations, and resolution priorities.
* Coordinates senior technical resources and cross\-functional teams during major customer\-impacting events.
* Communicates complex technical issues, risks, and decisions to customer executives and internal leadership.
* Leads post\-incident and post\-project reviews to identify root causes and organizational improvements.
* Makes recommendations that influence platform, product, service, and operational decisions.

**Team Leadership and Development**
-----------------------------------

* Provides functional leadership, technical direction, coaching, and mentorship to Technical Account Managers.
* Establishes and promotes consistent standards for account strategy, architecture reviews, documentation, and customer engagement.
* Reviews complex customer strategies and provides guidance on technical and relationship risks.
* Leads knowledge\-sharing sessions and develops reusable technical resources, frameworks, and best practices.
* Identifies team capability gaps and recommends training or development opportunities.

**Cross\-Functional Strategy and Continuous Improvement**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Represents strategic customer needs in product, platform, and operational planning.
* Synthesizes customer feedback and technical trends to identify broader service\-improvement opportunities.
* Leads cross\-functional initiatives that improve customer outcomes, internal processes, and technical service delivery.
* Develops scalable frameworks for technical health assessments, architecture reviews, and account planning.
* Partners with Sales and Customer Success on complex opportunities, renewals, and account\-growth strategies.
* Uses portfolio data and customer trends to influence organizational priorities and investment decisions.

**Judgment and Work Management**
--------------------------------

* Exercises advanced independent judgment in matters involving significant technical, customer, financial, or reputational impact.
* Balances customer objectives with technical feasibility, organizational capacity, and long\-term platform strategy.
* Prioritizes work across multiple strategic accounts and complex organizational initiatives.
* Operates with limited oversight and provides recommendations directly to senior leadership.
* Identifies and addresses emerging risks before they affect customer outcomes or business relationships.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* 4\+ years of experience in technical support, technical account management, customer success, systems administration, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience managing proactive technical relationships with customers.
* Bachelor’s degree

jobs.title: Territory Customer Support Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**


As part of the America’s team, SANY is looking to recruit a driven, forward\-thinking and highly motivated **Territory Customer Support Manager located in the North Central Region of the United States.** With the deep investment and backing of SANY Group, the Americas business expects to grow significantly in the coming years. Critical to this growth is the appointment of a high\-quality **TCSM** who is responsible for overseeing the development of the dealer(s) parts and service business aligned to Sany expectations.

  



SANY America is pursuing an aggressive growth strategy that requires a strong and consistent dealer network supporting the increased market share. This role will require someone who has the ability to multi\-task, understand the inner workings of a heavy equipment dealer organization and address technical product issues while being a problem solver that can create and improve processes with outside\-the\- box thinking.

  



With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase their market share.

  


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  



**Dealer Organization**


* Work with Sany teams select new dealer partners in strategically targeted markets.
* Assist in planning dealer readiness for receipt and dispatch of new equipment aligned to customer expectations.


* Ensure dealers have resources and facilities to safely and efficiently support SANY America and their customer base.
* Support technical diagnostics and troubleshooting for heavy equipment together with Technical Support Specialist and Dealer service personnel by utilizing an internal case system.
* Deliver dealership specific metrics to assist in meaningful KPI targets.
* Ensure all dealers are up to date on all product changes, service bulletins and SANY systems.
* Support technical service training to ensure dealer technicians are properly trained on SANY equipment and maintain appropriate skill level.


**Parts**


* Champion the use of SANY OEM parts to drive dealer revenue objectives.
* Assist dealers in maintaining a well\-stocked parts department to promptly respond to customer requirements.
* Provide parts guidance to dealers and customers when needed.
* Support the training of dealer parts personnel to ensure efficient use of Sany systems.


**Warranty**


* Provide support and clarity in the application of the SANY warranty policies and procedures as outlined in the Dealer Policy Manual.
* Support dealers in the timely submittal of warranty claims.
* Ensure 100% compliance on all mandatory safety related bulletins.

  


**Other Duties**


* Identify and report on product quality and emerging product reliability issues.
* Additional duties as assigned.

  


**PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS**  



 The ideal candidate will possess:

  


* Understanding of dealership daily operations.


* Minimum of 5 years of experience in the construction, industrial or agricultural equipment industry.
* A customer\-centric and service\-oriented mind\-set with a passion for customer service.


* Technical aptitude to diagnose and troubleshooting heavy equipment.
* Proficient computer use including Office 365suite.
* Attention to detail and critical view for continuous improvement to drive exceptional customer experience.
* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
* Understanding of collaborative teamwork.


* Strong organization and prioritizing skills.
* Ability to build trust and credibility with a variety of stakeholders to ensure the delivery of value\-based solutions.
* Valid Driver’s license with a clean driving record.
* Minimum educational requirement of a high school diploma.
* Ability to understand and read technical manuals, parts manual, electric and hydraulic schematics.
* Experience with service and parts department management.
* Technical College or similar Higher Education qualifications.
* Salesforce experience.

  


**T****RAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

  




* Preferred location is in the South Central Regions of the United States
* Must be willing to travel 50% to 70% of the time

  


**COMPENSATION**



Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience. It will include a base salary and other exceptional benefits


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**

SANY America is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

Propelus® simplifies workforce compliance management across healthcare. Our innovative technology and strategic partnerships empower millions of professionals, their employers, and regulators to work together, creating a connected and efficient healthcare ecosystem.


As a trusted leader for over 20 years, Propelus has focused on bringing more good into the lives of the people and organizations serving healthcare. We deliver seamless compliance solutions to millions. We leverage market\-leading technology and essential data to simplify complex operations, reduce risk, and champion a safer, healthier, and happier workforce.


The **Senior Customer Success Manager (Government)** is a strategic role designed for an expert navigator of the public sector where your work will make an a huge difference in nurses. You will act as the primary, strategic partner for our most complex clients, including government regulatory boards, regulators, departments of health, state agencies, and associations. This will require creating the tactics and adapting your approach to match the needs and goals of your stakeholders.


Success is defined by how effectively our technology supports the mission\-critical mandates of public safety and professional integrity. You will take end\-to\-end ownership of the customer lifecycle, align our platform with agency missions, drive measurable compliance outcomes, and ensure sustained value realization across your portfolio..

  

**What You’ll Do**


* **Strategic Relationship Management:** Serve as the primary owner for a portfolio of government regulatory boards and state agencies, building trusted relationships with Executive Directors and state officials to ensure long\-term stability.
* **Mission\-Aligned Strategy:** Develop the plans that align our technology with the specific agency mandates, Department of Health regulations, and public\-sector risk management priorities.
* **Regulatory Enablement:** Lead customized training programs that empower staff within regulators and associations to fully utilize the platform for audit readiness and governance excellence.
* **Health \& Usage Monitoring:** Take end\-to\-end ownership of monitoring engagement metrics, translating data into "State of the Agency" insights that demonstrate sustained value and support long\-term retention, and identify any potential problems that our solutions will help avoid.
* **Complex Issue Triage:** Act as the lead problem\-solver for complex account hurdles, collaborating with internal product and government affairs teams, navigating the unique requirements of the ever changing government landscape.
* **Business Reviews:** Conduct high\-level strategic reviews to assess progress, identifying opportunities to deepen the partnership and improve compliance outcomes for regulators and boards.

	+ Specifically managing government, regulatory, or public health accounts
	+ You understand the red tape, the RFP cycles, and the unique stakeholders of the public sector
* Direct experience with healthcare compliance, state departments of health, or professional licensing is strongly preferred


	+ You are comfortable speaking the language of regulators and state officials
* A self\-sufficient professional who thrives in a remote environment


	+ You will be taking over a complex book of business and navigating multi\-layered organizations with limited oversight
* Exceptional ability to communicate with non\-technical government leaders.


	+ You can distill complex software capabilities into a clear vision that aligns with public policy goals.

* Experience mentioning team members and external stakeholders
* Familiarity with Gainsight and HubSpot and Omni

**Account Manager**

About National Secure Transport  
National Secure Transport (NST) is an award\-winning, fast\-growing service provider with an ambitious mission: to be the leading national provider of full\-service cash management and related financial services in the cannabis space and beyond. Our services include cash\-in\-transit, cash vaulting, ATMs, and cashless payment systems. We currently operate in 33 states and are expanding rapidly.

We are an entrepreneurial company that moves quickly, works hard, and values team members who can work both tactically and strategically.

Our Core Values  
Integrity: Open, honest, ethical, accountable.  
Customer Service: Empathy, transparency, and appreciation in every interaction.  
Continuous Improvement: Incremental and breakthrough advances across products, services, and processes.  
Passion: We use our drive and commitment to energize, engage, and win.  
Teamwork: One team where all are welcomed and respected.

The Role  
The Account Manager owns NST's inbound lead flow. When a prospect reaches out, you are their first conversation with NST. Your job is to respond fast, understand what they need, match them to the right mix of NST services, and close the deal.

You'll put your time into turning interested prospects into signed customers and making sure each one gets the full value of what NST offers.

You will report to NST sales leadership and work closely with Operations and Accounting.

What You'll Own

Inbound Lead Management  
\- Respond to all inbound leads within one business day, whether they come from the website, phone, email, or events.  
\- Qualify each lead by learning the prospect's locations, cash volumes, current provider, and pain points.  
\- Move qualified leads through the full sales cycle, from first call to signed agreement.  
\- Follow up consistently so no lead goes cold.

Selling NST's Services  
\- Recommend the right combination of cash\-in\-transit, vaulting, ATMs, and cashless payments for each prospect.  
\- Present pricing, build proposals, and handle objections clearly and confidently.  
\- Find cross\-sell and upsell opportunities with every new customer.

Onboarding Handoff  
\- Make sure Operations and Accounting get complete, accurate agreement details.  
\- Work with Operations so new customers launch smoothly.  
\- Stay the customer's point of contact through launch.

CRM and Reporting  
\- Log every lead, call, and deal in Salesforce and keep records accurate and current.  
\- Track lead source, conversion rate, and time to close.  
\- Hit monthly KPIs and monthly and annual sales targets.

Product and Market Knowledge  
\- Keep deep, current knowledge of NST's services, pricing, and the regulatory environment.  
\- Share customer feedback and common questions with sales leadership to improve how we sell.

Operating Norms  
\- Be signed in and present in Roam, our cloud headquarters software, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time, Monday through Friday.  
\- Travel to trade shows when management asks.

What You Bring

Required  
\- At least 2 years of B2B sales experience with documented quota attainment.  
\- Experience handling a high volume of inbound leads and converting them into closed business.  
\- Skill with Salesforce or a similar CRM.  
\- Strong written and verbal communication. You come across as confident and professional on the phone, on video, and in person.  
\- A self\-starter who can work independently in a remote, fast\-moving environment.  
\- Strong follow\-up habits and attention to detail.

Strongly Preferred  
\- Sales experience in cash\-in\-transit, armored transport, logistics, payments, or financial services.  
\- Experience selling into cannabis or other regulated industries.

How You'll Be Measured  
\- New revenue closed from inbound leads.  
\- Lead response time.  
\- Lead\-to\-close conversion rate and time to close.  
\- Number of services sold per customer.  
\- CRM accuracy and pipeline hygiene.

Compensation and Benefits

Base Salary: $45,000 per year  
Commission: Structure discussed during the interview process  
Benefits: Benefits available, plus 401(k) and paid time off. Details are shared during the interview.  
Work Environment: Remote, Quarterly Trade Show Travel

Work Location

Remote

If this role excites you and you meet the qualifications above, we'd love to hear from you. Please send your resume and a short note about a time you turned an inbound lead into a customer and what made it work.

Equal Employment Opportunity

**Job Title: Workforce Management Analyst (Remote)**


**Location:** Remote \- United States


**Employment Type:** FT Hourly


**Compensation:** $30 per hour



**CareTalk Health**



CareTalk Health is a virtual\-only national medical practice delivering chronic care management and preventive care to Medicare members through health plan partnerships. The Clinical Operations Manager for Virtual Care Management owns the operations that carry a patient forward after the visit — care navigation, longitudinal chronic care management, and remote therapeutic monitoring.


**About the Role**



We're a virtual telehealth practice looking for a Workforce Management (WFM) Analyst to own forecasting, capacity planning, and analytics across our virtual clinic. You'll support scheduling and staffing for all key roles — Patient Support Specialists (PSS), RNs, and Providers.



This is a hands\-on analytical role, not a traditional WFM seat. You will build and refine forecasts working alongside AI tools we've developed in\-house. We're looking for someone genuinely curious about applying large language models (LLMs) and AI to forecasting and planning problems — comfort and curiosity here matter more than years on any one platform.



**Schedule**



This is a full\-time role working Monday – Friday 9am – 6pm ET. Some flexibility is needed based on clinic hours, which may include occasional evenings and Saturdays.


**Key Responsibilities**


**What You'll Do**



Forecast contact and demand volume and build capacity/staffing plans across teams * \- forecasting and analytics will be roughly 75% of the role.
* Monitor queues and staffing in real time, tracking adherence and service levels throughout the day and making intraday adjustments to keep coverage on target.
* Flag and respond to intraday risks — volume spikes, absences, and shifting demand — and communicate recommended adjustments to operations.
* Pull and combine source data from multiple inputs and analyze it to produce actionable staffing recommendations.
* Use our AI\-powered tools — and your own prompting and experimentation with LLMs — to generate, test, and validate forecasts against historical performance.
* Build and maintain reporting on key WFM metrics: occupancy, adherence, service levels, and staffing accuracy.
* Account for clinician licensing constraints (including multi\-state licensure) when planning clinician coverage, so the right licensed staff are available for the right patients.
* Collaborate with operational leadership to flag risks and recommend adjustments.


**Required**



* **Minimum of 2 years of experience as a workforce management** analyst or in a WFM operational role.
* **Contact center experience is required.**
* Hands\-on experience with real\-time queue monitoring and adherence in a contact center setting.
* Strong Excel skills, with the ability to work with data from multiple sources and turn it into clear forecasts and recommendations.
* AI fluency — comfort and curiosity using LLMs and AI tools in day\-to\-day analytical work.
* Clear communicator who can translate data into recommendations for non\-technical stakeholders.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Zoom Contact Center CX Analytics.

**Work Location Requirement**



This is a remote U.S.\-based position. Employees must perform all work physically within the United States. International work is not permitted during scheduled work hours.


**Work Environment**



This is a remote position and may be "on camera" at any time. You will work from a home office, requiring reliable internet connectivity and a secure, private workspace.

* **Computer:**
	+ Windows or Apple (macOS) Computer ONLY (NO Chromebooks, Linux Machines, or Smartphones)
	+ **Must** have at least Windows 10 or macOS 14 Sonoma.
* **Hardware:**
	+ Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Equivalent (Windows); Apple Silicon (Macs)

* **Headphones:** Wired headphones required for optimal audio quality. (NO built\-in mics)
* **Internet Speed:** Meet minimum internet speed requirements (100 MBPS download speed and 50 MBPS upload speed). Must have an ethernet cable connecting computer directly into router.
* **Browser and System:** Use Google Chrome with Amazon Workspaces (regardless of computer type).

**We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse**
=================================================


Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI\-ready APIs alongside traditional real\-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission\-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer\-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest\-growing SaaS vendors.


Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more.


To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital.


**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------


We’re hiring a builder\-operator to join our Business Operations team and work directly with Finance, Legal, Ops, and Recruiting to scale the systems and processes that run Stedi.


This role spans tools, numbers, and documentation – we want a hands\-on builder who’s also comfortable analyzing P\&Ls and customer agreements. You’ll build deep context on Stedi’s highest\-priority initiatives – then turn that context into durable workflows, integrations, and tooling that make the company run faster and more reliably.


You will work directly with the Head of Finance \& Operations to identify and prioritize the greatest opportunities across Stedi, define what “better” looks like, and ship new solutions – often by building it yourself.


This isn't a check\-the\-box or project management role. We need someone who can own ambiguous problems end\-to\-end, build scalable processes and real usable tools, and take on substantive work across Business Operations to help shape Stedi for the future.


The ideal candidate has relevant experience in integrations engineering, business operations, strategy, finance, or consulting. You don't need to know everything on day one, but you need to be excited to problem solve in unfamiliar territory. We hire for trajectory. If you bring excellent judgment, the work ethic, and the ability to pick up new subject matter quickly, we want to talk.


**What you'll do**
------------------


* Partner with senior leaders in Finance, Legal, People, Operations, and GTM to bring structure, insight, and velocity to top\-priority operational challenges
* Design and build tools, integrations, and automation that turn bespoke work into reusable workflows (e.g., ROI/margin calculators, pricing/packaging helpers, CPQ flows, FP\&A dashboards)
* Map and continuously improve data flows and processes across business systems (including ERP, CPQ, CLM, FP\&A) throughout the company
* Build and deploy AI\-enabled workflows (e.g., contracting support, deal desk triage, data validation) that increase speed and accuracy without compromising security and controls
* Build solution\-grade analytics that shape decisions – ranging from scrappy Excel analysis to durable dashboards, data models, and pipelines
* Develop and maintain full\-context documentation (e.g., SOPs, data flow diagrams, configs) so changes are auditable, repeatable, and don’t live in someone’s head

**Who you are**
---------------


* 3\+ years in integration engineering, consulting, finance, business operations, or similar roles in fast\-paced environments. You’ve developed strong judgment in at least one of these domains; broader experience is a plus. More senior candidates with broader experience are also encouraged to apply
* You are technical and hands\-on. You understand APIs/data models, can work in modern business systems, and can ship spreadsheets, scripts, automations, and lightweight apps – knowing when to pull in engineering
* You are analytical. You’re fluent in unit economics, margin mechanics, resource constraints, and you can build models that stand up to scrutiny
* You can ship – spreadsheets, scripts, automations, and lightweight apps – and you know when to pull in engineering vs. handle it yourself
* You think in systems. You design workflows and data models that scale, are observable, and don’t break quietly
* You thrive in ambiguity, create structure from chaos, and can independently design scalable processes from scratch
* You have high throughput and a bias to action – low ego, strong follow\-through, and you close loops
* You can communicate clearly and confidently with senior leaders both in writing and in conversation

**We’ve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team.** Please note:


* All official communication about roles at Stedi will **only come from an @****stedi.com** **email address**, or from our official identification verification partner, Persona, @frompersona.com.
* If you’re unsure whether a message is legitimate or have any concerns, feel free to **contact us directly at** **careers@stedi.com****.**

We appreciate your attention to this and your interest in joining Stedi.


*At Stedi, we're looking for people who are deeply curious and aligned to our ways of working. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.*
